'''Tasariq City spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The spaceport included [[Tasariq Control]], which operated as the communications center; [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] and berths for [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]; the [[Customs]] administration building; the command center known as the [[Port Authority Building]]; and the [[Imperial Navy Yard]].<ref name="J15" />
